children.text: Very low ratings put you at risk for deactivation. Learn more
Number of times customers thought you went 'Above and Beyond'.
Customer quotes from 5-star reviews will appear here.
Customer instructions are clearly labeled in the Dasher app. Try to follow them closely.
If an instruction is unclear or missing, call or text the customer through the app.
If you need additional help, contact Support and speak to an agent.
If unsure, always communicate with the customer, it’s best to review the address instructions at the restaurant while you wait. This will save you a lot of time.

Always communicate with the customer, that you will complete the delivery according to the delivery instructions. If you are missing info such as an apartment number, best to get the correct address at the restaurant while you wait. This is time you will save.
Always review drop off instructions before heading out to the customer. If anything is unclear, text or call the customer to verify the information.

First of all, always check for dropoff instructions! Often times customers have added them when they have had a bad experience with another dasher. Acknowledge you have seen the instructions with the customer, then make sure to clarify anything that doesn't make sense.
